name: list_kinds
description: List the kinds of thing the world model declares, each with its identifier, a one-line summary and how many live individuals it has (its specialisations included). Start here to learn the world model's vocabulary. Narrow the list with 'within' to a kind and its specialisations, and with 'present_only' to kinds that have individuals right now.

within.description: A kind's identifier, or its plain name when no other kind shares it; only that kind and its specialisations are listed.

present_only.description: List only kinds with live individuals.
